jobs.description:
Are you an electrician and do you know everything there is to know about wiring? Do you enjoy contributing to the construction of ships or installing and optimising the electrical networks of buildings? Then this vacancy is for you. 

What will you be doing? 
You are in the right place as an electrician. You can make a difference at various work locations with your electrical engineering knowledge and skills. One moment you may be working on building a luxury yacht, and the next you may be connecting the entire electrical network of a cruise ship. 
You may also find yourself in a place where the entire electrical system of a chalet or house needs to be installed. In addition, there is the possibility of being asked to solve electrical problems within mechanical engineering or existing buildings and schools. 
•    Working as an electrician at DB Work at various locations.
•    Applying your electrical engineering knowledge and skills to various projects.
•    Building luxury passenger yachts.
•    Connecting the entire electrical network of a cruise ship.
•    Installing electrical systems in chalets or homes.
•    Resolving electrical faults and problems within mechanical engineering.
•    Maintaining and repairing electrical systems in existing buildings and schools.

Who are you?
You are an enthusiastic electrician with a passion for your profession. You have knowledge of electrical engineering, gained through education or work experience, and you enjoy contributing your technical skills to a wide range of projects. In addition, you are motivated to live and work in the Netherlands and want to continue developing yourself within the field of electrical engineering.
You also recognize yourself in the following:
•    You have knowledge of electrical engineering through education or work experience.
•    You are eager to learn, enthusiastic and embrace new challenges.
•    You can work independently but also function well within a team.
•    You work accurately and safely with electrical installations.
•    You are motivated to live and work in the Netherlands.
•    You want to continue to develop yourself within the field.
•    You can communicate effectively in English.

About IQI

IQI Trusted Petfood Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality ingredients to premium pet food producers. These ingredients are derived from natural byproducts of the food chain. IQI oversees the entire value chain and is recognized as a co-creator of trusted premium pet food ingredients. Partner driven, Exceptional, Rock solid and Exploring are the core values of IQI. It is part of the OSI group since 2023.

jobs.employer_name: Boerma Instituut International Floral Design School
jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

You will work together in a team with other Spanish colleagues. From mise en place to preparing dishes during service.

• the toilet

• the balcony

jobs.description:
The U.S. Mission in Belgium is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the position of Registered Nurse in the Health Unit.

Jobomschrijving

The jobholder serves as the post’s nurse with responsibilities that include the medical care of Mission employees and eligible family members, utilizing MED approved clinical guidelines, as well as maintenance and inventory of all medical equipment and supplies, implementation of a robust vaccination program, documentation through the global electronic medical record, system administration of group and individual health education programs, and medical emergency contingency planning for the Mission.

With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

jobs.occupation: Machine Operator in a Modern Food Production Environment (F/X/M) –
jobs.description:

You’ll work with various machines such as sorters, weighing, and packaging systems, using MES software to monitor performance. You ensure production is safe, efficient, and meets quality standards.

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

As a Bodywork Assembler, you are responsible for disassembling and assembling vehicles as part of body repairs. You will work daily on both traditional and electric vehicles, paying extra attention to safety and precision, especially with electric systems. You follow established procedures and collaborate with colleagues to deliver the best results for every customer.

On a typical workday, you'll start by reviewing the scheduled repairs. You remove and install parts like bumpers, lighting, and other bodywork components. You regularly work on electric vehicles, strictly following the safety guidelines for high voltage and battery systems. Close collaboration with painters and panel beaters is essential to ensure smooth workflow and top quality. After assembly, you conduct thorough quality control.

Can you see yourself working in an innovative environment with the latest technologies and infrastructure? Apply now and join a team that values quality, innovation, and teamwork.

• At least 1 to 2 years of experience as a bodywork assembler, disassembler, or technician in a body shop environment

• Knowledge of electric vehicles, including batteries and high-voltage components

• Able to work accurately, structured, and independently

• Good command of spoken and written English

• Holder of a valid category B driver's license

• Diploma of higher secondary education or equivalent through experience
